fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Application Status 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (Ministry of Railway) has released Application Status / Exam Date for the recruitment of Technician Grade-I & Grade-III on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 6565 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Technician Recruitment 2026 were accepted from June 30, 2026, to July 29, 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 06-09 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB Technician CEN 02/2026 Application Status / Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 06-09 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General : Rs. 400/-
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
